name: Saigon Zoo and Botanical Gardens
kicker: The lake and gardens at Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm
summary: City zoo and gardens at 2 Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm: walk the lake and the lawns from 07:00, tickets until 17:30. A visitor 1.3 m and over pays 60,000 đồng. Closing is 18:30, and also 18:00. The history museum shares the street number.
getThere: 2 Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm, beside the History Museum.
heroCaption: The lake, the fountain, and the lawns inside the gardens

notice.title: Buy the ticket from the zoo
notice.body: Tickets are sold at the gate and on saigonzoo.vn. An online ticket lasts 30 days from the day it is issued. A paid online ticket stays sold.

body: Thảo Cầm Viên is at 2 Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm, Phường Sài Gòn. The History Museum uses the same street number with Phường Bến Nghé. The gate is open every day. Ticket sales run 07:00–17:30. Visiting runs until 18:30, and also until 18:00.

A visitor 1.3 m and over pays 60,000 đồng. A child from 1 m to under 1.3 m pays 40,000 đồng. A child from 1.3 m is also listed at 40,000 đồng. A child under 1 m is free with a parent. The butterfly garden is 08:00–16:30. The flamingo garden lists Tuesday–Thursday and weekend hours, and also a Monday-to-Friday disinfection closure. Read the board at that garden. The photograph is the lake. The second frame is the lawn, the elephant statue, and the trees.

figures.caption: The lawn and the elephant statue under the trees
figures.alt: Gardens and an elephant statue at Saigon Zoo

gettingThere: The gate is at 2 Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm, Phường Sài Gòn, beside the History Museum. From the cathedral square it is a ride.

legs.heading: From the cathedral square
legs.body: A ride to 2 Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm.

legs.heading: With the History Museum
legs.body: Same street number. The museum is closed on Monday and over lunch. The gardens are open every day.

hours: Ticket sales 07:00–17:30 every day. Visiting until 18:30, and also 07:00–18:00.
closed: The gate is open every day. The butterfly garden is 08:00–16:30. The flamingo garden lists Tuesday–Thursday and weekend hours, and also a Monday-to-Friday disinfection closure.
admissionNote: Visitor 1.3 m and over: 60,000 đồng. A child from 1 m to under 1.3 m: 40,000 đồng. A child from 1.3 m is also listed at 40,000 đồng. A child under 1 m is free with a parent. Buy at the gate or on saigonzoo.vn. An online ticket is valid for 30 days from issue. The sale is final. One QR code covers everyone in that purchase.
